#K medoid
```{r}
psilaut_dem <- read.xlsx("~/YANGE/Phd/shiftability/PSILAUT/hariri/psilaut_dem_outlier.xlsx")
AQ_DACS <- read.csv("~/YANGE/Phd/shiftability/PSILAUT/other_assessments/PSILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_CE_MD_5DASC.csv")
AQ_DACS <- AQ_DACS %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID)
psilaut_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(- "Sex", -"Group", -"IQ", -"Age", - "AQ") %>% 
  left_join(AQ_DACS)
psilaut_dem$Group <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Group)
psilaut_dem$Sex <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Sex)
psilaut_dem$Dose <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Dose)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 <- read.xlsx("ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_6aug.xlsx")

clu4 <- pam(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5[7:20],4, diss = FALSE, pamonce = 4, metric = "manhattan", stand = FALSE) 
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5$clu4 <- clu4$clustering
```

#data
```{r}
psilaut_dem <- read.xlsx("psilaut_dem_outlier.xlsx")
AQ_DACS <- read.csv("SILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_CE_MD_5DASC.csv")
AQ_DACS <- AQ_DACS %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID)
psilaut_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(- "Sex", -"Group", -"IQ", -"Age", - "AQ") %>% 
  left_join(AQ_DACS)
psilaut_dem$Group <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Group)
psilaut_dem$Sex <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Sex)
psilaut_dem$Dose <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Dose)

behavior_hariri <- read.xlsx("summary_behavior_hariri.xlsx")

task_regressor <- read.xlsx("task_regressor.xlsx", sheet = "clean")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 <- read.xlsx("ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_6aug.xlsx")

qs_psilaut <- read.xlsx("RBQ2A_OCIR.xlsx")
srs_psilaut <- read.xlsx("PSILAUT_SRS_Scores.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
sensory_psilaut <- read.xlsx("PSILAUT_sensory.xlsx")
had_psilaut <- read.csv("PSILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_AUTISM_YG.csv")
had_psilaut <- had_psilaut %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(HADS_A = mean(HADS_A), HADS_D = mean(HADS_D))
beh_pca <- read.xlsx("beh_pca.xlsx")

task_regressor <- read.xlsx("task_regressor.xlsx", sheet = "clean")
stimuli_type <- rep(task_regressor$stimuli_type, times = 102)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5$stimuli_type <- as.character(stimuli_type)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 %>% 
  filter(stimuli_type != "0")

```

#FO
```{r}
library(stateR)
n_cl4_block<- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit, stimuli_type) %>% 
  count(clu4) %>% 
  rename("cl4_n" = n) 
n_stimuli_block <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit) %>% 
  count(stimuli_type) 
fo_block_cl4_psilaut <- n_cl4_block %>% 
  full_join(n_stimuli_block) %>% 
  mutate( "perc" = cl4_n/n) %>% 
  select(-"cl4_n", -"n") 
fo_cl4_psilaut_block <- fo_block_cl4_psilaut %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu4, names_prefix = "fo_clu", values_from = perc)

n_cl4_times <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit, stimuli_times) %>% 
  count(clu4) %>% 
  rename("cl4_n" = n) 
n_stimuli <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit) %>% 
  count(stimuli_times) 
fo_cl4_psilaut_times <- n_cl4_times %>% 
  full_join(n_stimuli) %>% 
  mutate( "perc" = cl4_n/n) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"cl4_n", -"n") 
fo_cl4_psilaut_times <- fo_cl4_psilaut_times %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu4, names_prefix = "fo_clu", values_from = perc)
write.xlsx(fo_cl4_psilaut_times, "fo_cl4_psilaut_times.xlsx")

n_cl5 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit, stimuli_type) %>% 
  count(clu5) %>% 
  rename("cl5_n" = n) 
n_stimuli <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con %>%
  group_by(sub_visit) %>% 
  count(stimuli_type) 
fo_cl5_psilaut <- n_cl5 %>% 
  full_join(n_stimuli) %>% 
  mutate( "perc" = cl5_n/n) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"cl5_n", -"n") 
fo_cl5_psilaut_block <- fo_cl5_psilaut %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu5, names_prefix = "fo_clu", values_from = perc)
```

#DT
```{r}
dwt_psihar_cl4_block <-unnest(nest_dwell(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con, vars=c('sub_visit', 'stimuli_type'), foVar='clu4', sortBy=c('timepoint')), cols = c(data))
dt_cl4_psilaut_block <- dwt_psihar_cl4_block %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, names_prefix = "dt_clu", values_from = mean_dwell)

vars=c('sub_visit')
foVar='clu7'
sortBy=c('timepoint')

dwellCount <- function(x){

  f <- c(which(diff(x) != 0),length(x))

  y2 <- c(f[1],diff(f))
  y1 <- x[f]

  y <- list("cluster" = y1,
            "dwell" = y2)

  return(y)
}

vars_ <- dplyr::syms(vars)
  vars__ <- dplyr::syms(append(vars, 'cluster'))
  srt_ <- dplyr::syms(sortBy)

nest_dwell <- function(tbl, vars, foVar, sortBy){

  require(dplyr)
  require(tidyr)
  require(janitor)

  vars_ <- dplyr::syms(vars)
  vars__ <- dplyr::syms(append(vars, 'cluster'))
  srt_ <- dplyr::syms(sortBy)

  tbl %>%
    dplyr::rename('clus' = all_of(foVar)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!vars_) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(!!!srt_) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(clus = list(clus)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = purrr::map(clus, dwellCount)) %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::select(-clus) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(c(cluster, dwell)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    # dplyr::filter(dwell != 1) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!vars__) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_dwell = mean(dwell)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    tidyr::nest()

}
```

### visual PCA
```{r}
library(corrplot)
library(Hmisc)
library(RColorBrewer)
M_3 <- cor(beh_pca[3:12])
colnames(M_3) <- c("HADS-A", "HADS-D", "AASP", "SRS-2", "RBQ2-A", "PC 1", "PC 2", "PC 3", "PC 4", "PC 5")
rownames(M_3) <- c("HADS-A", "HADS-D", "AASP", "SRS-2", "RBQ2-A", "PC 1", "PC 2", "PC 3", "PC 4", "PC 5")
corrplot(M_3, method="circle", # order="alphabet", 
         type="lower", 
         # addCoef.col = "black", # Add coefficient of correlation
         # tl.col="black", tl.srt=45, #Text label color and rotation
         col = brewer.pal(n = 8, name="BuPu"),
         col.lim = c(-1, 1), # Ensure the color scale stays anchored at -1 to 1
         # Combine with significance
         # p.mat = p.mat, sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=FALSE 
         )
```

```{r}
fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- beh_pca %>% 
  right_join(fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)
fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  drop_na(c(18:33))
fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  mutate(fo_clu3_diff = fo_clu3_shape_5 - fo_clu3_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(fo_clu2_diff = fo_clu2_shape_5 - fo_clu2_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(fo_clu1_diff = fo_clu1_shape_5 - fo_clu1_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(fo_clu4_diff = fo_clu4_shape_5 - fo_clu4_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(DASC_total_diff = DASC_total_5 - DASC_total_0) %>% 
  mutate(DASC_totalp_diff = DASC_totalp_5 - DASC_totalp_0) 

fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide_au <- fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  filter(Group == "1")

summary(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu3_diff) ~ scale(Comp.1)  + scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0)))
confint(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu3_diff) ~ scale(Comp.1)  + scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0)), level = 0.95)

fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide$RES_fo_clu3_diff <- resid(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu3_diff) ~ scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0)))

summary(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu2_diff) ~  scale(Comp.1)+ scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) ))
confint(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu2_diff) ~ scale(Comp.1)  + scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0)), level = 0.95)

fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide$RES_fo_clu2_diff <- resid(lm(data = fo_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(fo_clu2_diff) ~ scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0)))
```

##DT
```{r}
dt_cl4_psilaut_block <- read.xlsx("dt_cl4_psilaut_block_ALL_6aug.xlsx")
dt_cl4_psilaut_block <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(sub_visit, Dose, meanFD_hariri, CNS_no, PSILAUT_no,  Age, Sex, IQ, AQ, Group) %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block)
dt_cl4_psilaut_block[12:15][is.na(dt_cl4_psilaut_block[12:15])] <- 0
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- dt_cl4_psilaut_block %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"sub_visit") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stimuli_type, values_from = c(11:14, meanFD_hariri))
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(Dose, CNS_no, PSILAUT_no, DASC_total, DASC_totalp) %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dose, values_from = c(11:18, meanFD_hariri_face, meanFD_hariri_shape,DASC_total, DASC_totalp))
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  drop_na(c(8:23))

dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide %>% 
  mutate(dt_clu3_diff = dt_clu3_shape_5 - dt_clu3_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(dt_clu2_diff = dt_clu2_shape_5 - dt_clu2_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(dt_clu1_diff = dt_clu1_shape_5 - dt_clu1_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(dt_clu4_diff = dt_clu4_shape_5 - dt_clu4_shape_0) %>% 
  mutate(DASC_total_diff = DASC_total_5 - DASC_total_0) %>% 
  mutate(DASC_totalp_diff = DASC_totalp_5 - DASC_totalp_0) 
  
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- qs_psilaut %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- srs_psilaut %>% 
  select(-"X16") %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID) %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- sensory_psilaut %>% 
  rename("CNS_no" = ID) %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)
dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide <- beh_pca %>% 
  right_join(dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide)

summary(lm(data = dt_cl4_psilaut_block_wide, scale(dt_clu2_diff) ~ scale(Comp.1) + scale(Age) + Sex + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_0) + scale(meanFD_hariri_face_5) ))


```
